continuation_context.critical_insight: right_gap_class_definable (getting temporal formula R for the gap property) is NECESSARY but NOT SUFFICIENT for the contradiction. R being constant (all classes end at gaps) does not itself give False. The contradiction comes from model surgery: excise a bad interval, show temporal truth is preserved in surgery model, but R changes truth value at the surgery boundary (gap becomes successor-pair boundary). This IS the Reynolds Lemmas 10-13 argument.
